explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because Python f-strings embed self.language and self.chat_id directly into the UPDATE query. A user supplying a crafted language string could alter the UPDATE statement to modify other users' rows or execute unauthorized SQL operations. The repair substitutes %s placeholders and passes (self.language, self.chat_id) as a tuple to db.add(), though complete safety depends on the unseen db.add wrapper.
